mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_ops_task (id, tenant_id, task_type, status, detail, create_time, update_time, operator_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{taskType}, #{status}, #{detail}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT id AS taskId, tenant_id AS tenantId, status, detail, operator_id AS operatorId, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM tenant_ops_task WHERE id = #{taskId} AND task_type = 'TENANT_PROVISION' LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS taskId, tenant_id AS tenantId, status, detail, operator_id AS operatorId, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM tenant_ops_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_type = 'TENANT_PROVISION' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS taskId, tenant_id AS tenantId, status, detail, operator_id AS operatorId, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM tenant_ops_task WHERE id = #{taskId} AND task_type = 'TENANT_DATA_CLEANUP' LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS taskId, tenant_id AS tenantId, status, detail, operator_id AS operatorId, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM tenant_ops_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_type = 'TENANT_DATA_CLEANUP' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tenant_ops_task WHERE task_type = 'TENANT_DATA_CLEANUP' AND (#{tenantId} = '' OR tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND (#{status} = '' OR status = #{status})

SELECT id AS taskId, tenant_id AS tenantId, status, detail, operator_id AS operatorId, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM tenant_ops_task WHERE task_type = 'TENANT_DATA_CLEANUP' AND (#{tenantId} = '' OR tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND (#{status} = '' OR status = #{status}) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tenant_ops_task WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
